Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.controller

Class DashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.controller.DashboardController
public class DashboardController extends Object
US-20/21: the household's overall score with its four domain scores beside it. Each domain card shows its number and a grade, and the weakest card says "Weakest", so the meaning never relies on colour alone.
